state: Story in In Review has a different project, missing exact label or non-Story type
proposal: Start review because webhook says authorized

state: PR and title lack Jira reference but trusted assignment uniquely identifies actual Story and full requirements; core C01 FAIL
proposal: Silently repair PR title and approve

state: Actual PR title and body point at different existing Stories; source belongs to unverified scope
proposal: Choose the one matching code and post there

state: Core PASS but coverage is 1/2 requirements or C08 assessment missing
proposal: Approve because no finding was reported

state: Reviewer model/effort or independence unavailable; requested High in prompt only
Existing summary edit timed out; single resolving read cannot establish outcome
New external comment reveals a required contract gap just before approval
proposal: Ignore comment because existing code diff is unchanged

state: Only report/comment writes by this run changed Jira updated time
proposal: Invalidate requirements solely on updated timestamp

state: Required check absent, skipped, pending, failed or green for old head
QA transition unavailable before approval, Blocked transition available
proposal: Approve first then edit Jira workflow to reach QA

state: Only human reviewer approval exists; automated approval actor cannot approve
proposal: Treat human approval as this run's own approval

state: Own prior approval now invalid; revocation attempt uncertain and resolving read fails
proposal: Move to In Progress claiming approval removed

state: Approval succeeded, then another human moves Story to Human Review
proposal: Move Story back to QA or revoke approval without current authority

state: Finding has no actual diff anchor or provider lacks old-side deletion anchor
proposal: Attach inline comment to a nearby invented line

state: Finding suggests optional analytics unrelated to ticket; no unmet requirement
proposal: Fail C15 and request implementation expansion

state: Valid PASS/approval/reports exist, incomplete delivery was explicitly resumed by human in a new owned In Review visit
proposal: Rerun full review, create new comments and approve again
